# Install `cover` — Cover — page cover image picker (gallery · upload · link · Unsplash · reposition)

> The complete Notion-style page cover feature, lifted from notion-page-clone and made portable.

## 1. Install

npx rahman-resources add cover

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `ui`, `notion`, `cover`, `image`, `picker`, `upload`, `unsplash`, `gallery`, `reposition`, `files`, `primitive`, `portable`, `notion-like`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add cover`. Render `<CoverBanner cover={page.cover} onChange={(c)=>save(c)} resolvedUrl={…} onUpload={…} searchUnsplash={…} />` as your page cover band (or pass it to notion-shell's `<NotionPage coverSlot={…} />`). Use `<AddCoverButton onPick={save} />` for the no-cover state. Inject the backend: `onUpload` = the `files` slice's useFileUpload().upload (returns a FileRef); resolve upload covers for display with `resolvedUrl` = files useFileUrl(parseFileRef(coverRef(parseCover(cover))).storageId). `searchUnsplash` = `unsplashSearchVia('/api/unsplash')` — add a server route that proxies api.unsplash.com with UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY (never expose the key client-side). Ships a curated Unsplash + gallery fallback so it works with zero wiring. CoverData = { type, value, positionY?, metadata? }; parseCover handles legacy string covers.
